english.note: Use 有趣 as the all-purpose choice for something that engages your attention or holds your interest.
Use this for something entertaining or interesting in a broader sense, even when it is not laugh-out-loud funny.

examples.english: This book about marine life is interesting.
examples.traditional: 呢本書講海洋生物，好有趣。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bun2 syu1 gong2 hoi2 joeng4 sang1 mat6 hou2 jau5 ceoi3

examples.english: This book about Hong Kong’s old districts is quite amusing.
examples.traditional: 呢本講香港舊區嘅書幾有趣。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bun2 gong2 hoeng1 gong2 gau6 keoi1 ge3 syu1 gei2 jau5 ceoi3
